title: Check: Area of a Triangle Using Sine

questions.stem: A triangle has sides $a = 10\text{ cm}$ and $b = 14\text{ cm}$ with an included angle of $45°$. What is its exact area?
A triangle has an area of $30\text{ cm}^2$, one side of $10\text{ cm}$, and an adjacent side of $12\text{ cm}$. What is the included angle?
When is the formula $\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ most useful compared to $\frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}$?

options.text: When you know the perpendicular height
When you know two sides and the included angle but not the height
When you only know one side

questions.explanation: The sine area formula is most useful when you know two sides and the included angle, making it unnecessary to calculate the perpendicular height.
